title: CMA-ES Staged-Chirp Defect Cavity (21 Layers)
scientific_hypothesis: CMA-ES optimizer with covariance matrix adaptation seeded from iteration-32 optimal thicknesses will escape local minima that caused gradient-based optimizer score regression, achieving target_score > 0.95 with staged chirp constraints (±10% initial, ±25% expanded).
design_principle: Defective DBR structure (HL)^N D(LH)^N with quarter-wave mirrors and half-wave defect cavity at 1550 nm. CMA-ES population-based search exploits promising basin discovered in iteration 32 while staged chirp prevents premature convergence.
proposed_topology: exactly 5 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs, one cavity layer, and exactly 5 reverse-order pairs (21 finite layers)
manufacturing_considerations: adjacent layer thickness difference constraint for deposition uniformity
quarter-wave base provides fabrication-friendly starting point
theory_basis: Defective DBR bandpass filter theory: (HL)^N D(LH)^N structure creates transmission peak at defect mode wavelength
Quarter-wave optical thickness n*d = lambda0/4 for mirrors, n*d = lambda0/2 for cavity
expected_advantages: CMA-ES avoids gradient-based local minima trapping
Staged chirp balances exploration and convergence
21 layers leaves margin for future complexity increase
known_risks: CMA-ES may require more function evaluations than gradient methods
Staged protocol may delay convergence if chirp expansion timing is suboptimal
execution_request_english: Design a 21-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 defect-cavity bandpass filter on fused silica substrate with air incident medium. Layer sequence: alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 starting with Ta2O5, layer 11 is the defect cavity. Initialize all layers within ±10% of quarter-wave thickness at 1550 nm (Ta2O5 ~185 nm, SiO2 ~267 nm, cavity ~534 nm). Constrain chirp slope to maximum 3% thickness change per interface. Use CMA-ES optimizer with population size 20, seeded with thickness vector [209.8257105224059, 220.79821841120258, 214.56223999475006, 185.44557829172606, 226.69413733242868, 233.2332709326123, 96.19862533257114, 95.2239899876587, 184.9256993446736, 183.53306613797727, 337.39530803995683, 211.76520107676225, 165.31201322409683, 178.26505740914925, 274.47316942425505, 142.75439461585967, 241.4702554145756, 365.64105969518573, 377.85960538578905, 349.3859455073734, 303.5795815352078]. Evaluate transmittance at normal incidence for wavelengths 1400-1700 nm. Optimize for high transmittance at 1550 nm and low transmittance in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm bands. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 5 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs, one cavity layer, and exactly 5 reverse-order pairs (21 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1400-1500 nm, 1550-1550 nm, 1600-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance at 1550 nm (soft target ≥ 0.95); strong suppression of transmittance in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 1400-1500 nm; transmittance in 1600-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: switch from gradient-based to CMA-ES optimizer with staged-chirp protocol, seeded from iteration-32 optimal thicknesses to exploit discovered promising basin.
